name: GL1TCH
author: kar1775
description: The secret way is actually 17-86%: Hold up a little bit just after passing the gear at 17% (after your icon has been teleported three times) and then release for a tiny bit and then hold up again to go to the ceiling while avoiding a wall of blocks. Move to the floor at 18% and stay there. Start holding at 56% and then release around 57.6% to re-enter the level as the ship. Play through the following gameplay as the ship until 60% where you have to stay on the floor. Fly up a tiny bit at 62.9% and land on the right side of the red pad without touching the ball portal to make it into the following section. Play through the following section as the ball and then stay at the floor at 66%. Play through the gameplay as the robot at 69% and then stay at the floor. Play through the section as the wave at 75% and then when you reach the ship portal at 79%, hold to the ceiling and then release around 81.4% to enter the dual portal. Navigate through the gameplay only as player one until you can fall under the level when your ship is about to hit the platform at 84.0%. Navigate through the gameplay as player two once the icon comes back on screen until 86.0%-86.1% where you can fall below the level shortly before the ship portal (you can’t fall of the platform without clicking, you need to time it). Hold as player one only from around 86.2%-87.0% to re-enter the level as the ball at 91% while only being player one and then spam until you get moved back to the floor (either at 91.5% after the blue pads or at. 92% after the yellow orb). At 94%, you will be moved back into the level as the spider. Continue while playing the level normally from there
